> **Beta of this fork** of [iqui27/nuvio-native-legacy](https://github.com/iqui27/nuvio-native-legacy), built on upstream 2.0.5. Samsung packages: Tizen 6.5–7 (`NuvioTpk65`) and Tizen 8–9 (`NuvioTpk`). It is a pre-release, so installed apps do not auto-update to it: install the `.tpk` by hand (Apps2Samsung).

## Sources
- **"Dubbed" filter** is now just Spanish (Castilian) → English → off.

## Languages
- **Latin American Spanish** and **Portuguese (BR)** in Settings › Audio language and Subtitle language, next to Spanish and Portuguese. Existing settings are kept.
- Choosing one of them puts sources in that variant first in the automatic pick.

## Home
- New **"Logos on cards"** setting (Home screen › More options): the movie or series logo on landscape cards, in place of the name.
- The expanded **Top 10** shows portrait posters instead of a squeezed backdrop.
- A row set to **"Portrait poster"** stays portrait even with landscape posters on; with them off, rows named after a service or an award are portrait too.
- Series catalogs from AIOMetadata are labelled as series, not movies.
- Expanded cards now **close with an animation**, and opening/closing no longer flickers or zooms.

## Since 2.0.5-b1
Everything above. See [v2.0.5-b1](https://github.com/albertovinaroz/nuvio-native-legacy/releases/tag/v2.0.5-b1) for the audio and subtitle flags on every source.
